programs.program_name: SNAP / Food Stamps
programs.eligibility: Income < 130% FPL statewide.
programs.apply_notes: Provides food benefits to low-income individuals and families.

programs.program_name: Greater Chicago Food Depository
programs.eligibility: Anyone in Cook County needing food assistance.
programs.apply_notes: Provides food assistance through a network of partner agencies, pantries, and hot meal programs.

programs.program_name: Illinois Food Bank Association — Statewide Network
programs.eligibility: Anyone in need, all 102 Illinois counties.
programs.apply_notes: A network of 9 regional food banks and over 2,000 partner agencies serving all 102 Illinois counties.

programs.program_name: WIC (Illinois WIC Program)
programs.eligibility: Pregnant women, postpartum women, infants, children under 5 — income < 185% FPL.
programs.apply_notes: Provides food benefits, nutrition counseling, breastfeeding support, and referrals for pregnant women, postpartum women, infants, and children under 5.

programs.program_name: Illinois Medicaid / Medicaid Expansion
programs.eligibility: Adults 19–64 to 138% FPL (expanded). Families, children, pregnant women, seniors, disability.
programs.apply_notes: Provides healthcare coverage to low-income adults, families, children, pregnant women, seniors, and individuals with disabilities.

programs.program_name: Cook County Health (CCH) — Stroger Hospital + CountyCare
programs.eligibility: Cook County residents.
programs.apply_notes: Public hospital system for Cook County residents, including a Level 1 trauma center and a Medicaid managed care plan.

programs.program_name: Chicago Department of Public Health (CDPH) — City Clinics
programs.eligibility: Chicago residents.
programs.apply_notes: Provides sliding scale primary care, sexual health, mental health, substance use, and maternal health services to Chicago residents.

programs.program_name: Illinois Immigrant Health Connect (State-Funded)
programs.eligibility: Undocumented immigrants age 42+ — income < 138% FPL.
programs.apply_notes: State-funded healthcare coverage for undocumented immigrants age 42+.

programs.program_name: Federally Qualified Health Centers — Illinois Network
programs.eligibility: Anyone regardless of insurance status or ability to pay.
programs.apply_notes: Provides sliding scale primary, dental, and behavioral health services regardless of insurance status or ability to pay.

programs.program_name: Illinois Housing Development Authority (IHDA) — Emergency Rental Assistance
programs.eligibility: Low-income Illinois renters facing eviction or housing instability — income < 80% AMI.
programs.apply_notes: Administers state-level rental assistance programs for low-income renters facing eviction or housing instability.

programs.program_name: Chicago RLTO Tenant Hotline — Metropolitan Tenants Organization (MTO)
programs.eligibility: Chicago renters covered by RLTO.
programs.apply_notes: Provides free tenant rights counseling, habitability complaints, security deposit disputes, and eviction defense for Chicago renters covered by the RLTO.

programs.program_name: Illinois Legal Aid Online (ILAO) — Statewide Self-Help
programs.eligibility: Anyone in Illinois.
programs.apply_notes: Provides free legal information, court forms, and self-help guides for housing, family, benefits, and consumer issues.

programs.program_name: Illinois Domestic Violence Hotline
programs.eligibility: 24/7 statewide.
programs.apply_notes: Provides 24/7 crisis support, shelter referral, and safety planning for domestic violence survivors.

programs.program_name: Chicago Domestic Violence Help Line
programs.eligibility: Chicago DV survivors.
programs.apply_notes: Provides 24/7 crisis support, shelter, legal advocacy, and a City Hall Domestic Violence Help Desk for Chicago DV survivors.

programs.program_name: Legal Aid Chicago (formerly LAF)
programs.eligibility: Income < 200% FPL, Cook County and collar counties.
programs.apply_notes: Provides legal assistance in housing, family, benefits, DV, immigration, and consumer matters.

programs.program_name: Prairie State Legal Services — Downstate + Suburban
programs.eligibility: Income-qualified residents, 36 counties in northern and central Illinois outside Cook.
programs.region: 36 counties in northern and central Illinois outside Cook
programs.apply_notes: Provides legal assistance in housing, family, benefits, DV, elder, and immigration matters.

programs.program_name: Land of Lincoln Legal Aid — Southern Illinois
programs.eligibility: Income-qualified residents, 65 counties in central and southern Illinois.
programs.region: 65 counties in central and southern Illinois
programs.apply_notes: Provides legal assistance in housing, family, benefits, DV, elder, and consumer matters.

programs.program_name: Equip for Equality — Disability Rights Illinois
programs.eligibility: People with disabilities throughout Illinois.
programs.apply_notes: Provides legal representation and advocacy for people with disabilities on issues such as ADA, Section 504, abuse/neglect, special education, and healthcare rights.

programs.program_name: TANF Cash Assistance (Illinois DHS — TCA)
programs.eligibility: Families with children, income < 50% FPL.
programs.apply_notes: Provides cash assistance to families with children.

programs.program_name: Illinois Unemployment Insurance (IDES)
programs.eligibility: Workers who lost job through no fault of their own.
programs.apply_notes: Provides temporary income to workers who have lost their job through no fault of their own.

programs.program_name: LIHEAP / IHWAP (Illinois Home Weatherization & Energy Assistance)
programs.eligibility: Income < 200% FPL.
programs.apply_notes: Provides heating, cooling, crisis utility shutoff prevention, and weatherization assistance.

programs.program_name: ComEd Low Income Programs
programs.eligibility: ComEd electric customers with income < 200% FPL.
programs.apply_notes: Provides rate reduction and deferred payment plans for low-income electric customers.
